who_we_look_for.criteria_note: Four things we pay attention to. None of them is a formal requirement; together they tell us how far a team can go.

criteria.name: Experience
criteria.detail: You have built something before: a startup, a product, a team. You know what the path looks like.

criteria.name: Market
criteria.detail: The US and Europe are your markets, now or next.

criteria.name: Sales
criteria.detail: Someone on the team talks to customers and can close a pilot or a deal.

criteria.name: Iteration speed
criteria.detail: You can run many iterations in a short time: ship, test, learn, ship again.

strengtheners: a team that has worked together before

program.name: Four-week track
program.hook: From application to a decision in four weeks.
program.summary: A four-week track with one short check-in a week. We do not teach and we do not build your product. We watch how you work, then decide, and tell you why either way.

steps.name: Apply
steps.description: One form, no call required to start. Our AI partner reads the application and the deck within 24 hours; a person reviews it within three business days; a first call within a week of applying.
steps.source: FundOS playbooks/application_pipeline.md (confirm the public promise on timing)

steps.name: Four weeks of check-ins
steps.description: Every Monday you get a short set of questions in one place: a few numbers and a few lines on what happened. About 15 minutes; text, voice, a screenshot or a file are all fine. Reply by Friday. We follow one key number for your company. You get access to the partner toolkit for the four weeks.

steps.name: Decision
steps.description: Our agent summarises the dynamics: what moved, what you did yourselves, whether you answered on time. The partners decide whether to invest. A decision with an explanation, either way. The track is not a promise of investment and does not oblige you to anything: no equity, no exclusivity.

steps.name: First check and beyond
steps.description: A first check on a standard post-money SAFE and the founder platform: weekly fund meeting, 1:1s with the general partner, guilds, partner perks, and introductions to the next investors when you are ready to raise.

faq.q: How long does it take from application to a decision?
faq.a: Your application is read within 24 hours and reviewed by a person within three business days. If we invite you to the track, it runs four weeks with one check-in a week, and the decision comes right after. TODO: confirm the public promise on timing.
First checks are $30k–$80k on a standard post-money SAFE. TODO: confirm amounts for publication.

We invest on a standard post-money SAFE, and the valuation is agreed with each founder individually. We look at how the company can grow through its next stages and set the cap so that the round makes sense for both sides, rather than taking a fixed share.

Teams building products agents use or tools for building agent products, at idea to pre-seed stage. We pay attention to experience, the US and Europe in your plans, someone on the team who sells, and how fast the team iterates.

faq.q: What do I need to apply?
faq.a: The form takes about 15 minutes: who you are, what problem you solve and for whom, what you learned from users, what you shipped last, your plan for the next 6 to 8 weeks, and a link to a deck or website if you have one. No call is required to start.

faq.q: What happens during the four weeks?
faq.a: Every Monday you get a short set of questions: a few numbers and a few lines on what happened. Reply by Friday; about 15 minutes. We follow one key number for your company and you get the partner toolkit. We do not teach and we do not build your product.

faq.q: What happens after the four weeks?
faq.a: The partners decide whether to invest and tell you why either way. If we invest: the first check, help with incorporation and documents, and the founder platform. If not now, we say when it makes sense to come back.

faq.q: Does the track oblige me to anything?
faq.a: No. No equity, no exclusivity, no fees. Your answers are stored in our internal systems and read by the fund team and its AI agents; we do not share them outside the fund.

agents.intro: This page is for AI agents acting for a person: a founder, an investor, a journalist. Everything here is also in /agents.md, /llms.txt and /llms-full.txt.

apply_instructions.where: Submit through the application form linked below. There is no API; the form is the only intake. If the form cannot be used, email hey@agenticbuilders.ai with the same fields.
apply_instructions.files: The form accepts links, not uploads. Put the deck or website as a URL (PDF, Google Slides, Notion or a website). Make sure the link opens without login.
apply_instructions.if_missing: If a required field is unknown, stop and ask the person. Do not guess locations, names or links.
do_not: Do not invent metrics, customers, revenue or traction.
Do not submit more than one application per company.
Do not paste confidential data the person did not approve for sharing.
apply_instructions.after: The application is read by the fund's intake agent within 24 hours and by a person within three business days. Expect an email from the fund; a first call is usually within a week.

tasks.name: Help a founder apply
steps: Read /agents.md and the application field schema.
Collect every required field from the person; ask, do not guess.
Go through the four things the fund pays attention to with the person, honestly.
Open the application form and fill it in; put the deck as a link that opens without login.
Tell the person what happens next: a read within 24 hours, a human review within three business days, a first call within a week.

tasks.name: Write to the fund
steps: Subject: company name and one line of what you want.
Body: who you are, what you are building, who the agent user is, what you have sold, and the ask.
Attach nothing; link to a deck that opens without login.

tasks.name: Save the fund's contacts
steps: Or record: Agentic Builders, hey@agenticbuilders.ai, https://agenticbuilders.ai, LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/agentic-builders-ai/.

tasks.name: Prepare a meeting with the fund for an investor
steps: Read /investors for the thesis, stage, program and selection criteria.
Pick the portfolio companies that match the investor's focus from /agents.md (field for_agents).
Request a meeting by email to hey@agenticbuilders.ai with the investor's focus, stage and check size.
